chip.pendingHint: An admin still has to approve it. Until then only you can see it.

combobox.proposeHint: You can use it on your table right away, but nobody else sees it until an admin approves it.

admin.title: Catalogs
admin.description: Systems, tags and platforms that describe the tables. Each group gathers the names that mean the same thing.
admin.emptyTitle: There is nothing in this catalog yet
admin.emptyDescription: Whatever masters propose from the table wizard shows up here for you to review.
admin.emptySearchDescription: No value matches what you searched for.
admin.acceptDialogDescription: Decide whether this is a new value or another way of writing one that already exists.
admin.acceptAsNewGroupHint: It becomes the main entry of its own group. You can merge it later if an equivalent turns up.
admin.acceptAsAliasHint: “{{name}}” becomes equivalent to the chosen group: searching for either one brings back the same tables.
admin.rejectConfirmDescription: It will not be shown and cannot be filtered by. You can accept it later if you change your mind.
admin.mergeDialogDescription: The group you pick is the one that stays; “{{name}}” becomes one more way of naming it.
admin.mergeHint: “{{source}}” and all of its equivalents move into the chosen group. No table changes: the ones already tagged are still found, under either name.
admin.splitConfirmDescription: It stops being equivalent to the rest and becomes a value of its own. The tables tagged with it do not change.
admin.splitSuccess: “{{name}}” is now a value of its own
admin.disableDialogDescription: It stops being shown and stops filtering, but nothing is deleted.
admin.disableKeepsLinks: The tables using it keep it. If you restore it, everything comes back as it was.
admin.disableNeedsSuccessor_one: It is the main entry of a group with one other value. Pick which one becomes the main entry:
admin.disableNeedsSuccessor_other: It is the main entry of a group with {{count}} other values. Pick which one becomes the main entry:
admin.promoteConfirmDescription: “{{name}}” becomes the head of the group and “{{head}}” one more synonym. Nobody leaves the group and no table changes.
admin.promoteSuccess: “{{name}}” is the group's new main value
admin.reassignDialogDescription: It stops being a synonym of its current group and becomes one of the group you pick. Tables tagged with it do not change.
admin.graphEmptyDescription: This group no longer exists and no proposal is waiting.
admin.groupDescription: The main value in the centre, its synonyms around it and, to the left, what nobody has classified yet.
admin.trayDescription: To move a synonym or merge, both groups have to be on the canvas.
admin.gestureAccept: Drag a proposal onto a main value to accept it into that group.
admin.gestureReassign: Drag a synonym onto another main value to move it.
admin.gestureMerge: Drag a main value onto another to merge the two groups.
admin.gestureSplit: Select a connection and press Delete to split that synonym out.
admin.gestureMenu: All of this is also in each value's “…” menu.
admin.createDescription: It is born accepted, as a group of its own. If it is a synonym of another one, join them afterwards from the group's canvas.
admin.acceptConfirmDescription: It starts showing to players and filtering tables.
admin.createConfirmDescription: It is born accepted, as a group of its own: it shows and filters tables right away.
admin.disableConfirmDescription: It leaves circulation without breaking any link: tables using it keep it, and it can be restored.
admin.mergeReviewDescription: The whole group of the first becomes equivalent to the other, and stops having a principal of its own.
admin.reassignConfirmDescription: It leaves its current group and becomes equivalent to the new one. Tables using it are not touched.
admin.restoreConfirmDescription: It comes back into circulation with everything it had: it shows and filters tables again.
admin.acceptIntoConfirmDescription: It starts showing and filtering, and searching either one finds the tables of both.
admin.proposeConfirmDescription: An admin reviews it. Meanwhile your table can use it, but it does not show to players or filter.
